pipeline: job:live: RENDER_PROVIDER=composite (v2), VERIFIER_PROVIDER=meta (Muse Spark 1.3, api.meta.ai), MODEL_SEGMENT meta/sam-3.1 (api.meta.ai), SEGMENT_PROMPT shirt (transform cases) or kurta (case 10); thresholds unchanged

rows.actual_reason: render_quality: CompositeQualityReview: over- or under-exposed photo

rows.note: needs real photo, not run: a busy background has to be photographed; pasting a texture behind a cut-out would test the paste, not the phone photo

rows.pain: creased hem read as hem mismatch
rows.note: needs real photo, not run: creases are fabric folds; no pixel transform makes them
needs real photo, not run: a folded garment has to be folded and photographed

rows.pain: odd mirror angle, no person, hem uncertain
rows.note: needs real photo, not run: a mirror shot needs the mirror; a warp of the flat photo is not one

rows.pain: printed fabric moire, confident print_pattern mismatch
rows.note: needs real photo, not run: moire comes from the camera sensor meeting the print; synthetic moire would be a guess

rows.actual_reason: render_quality: CompositeQualityReview: harsh shadow across the garment; retake in shade

rows.pain: sleeve or hem cut off at frame edge
rows.actual_reason: render_quality: CompositeQualityReview: garment is cut off at the edge of the photo
render_quality: CompositeQualityReview: photo resolution too low
hard_mismatch: color: mismatch at 0.98 on a hard attribute
rows.note: the image to publish is data/garments/kurta-02/1-front.jpg, the sources are kurta-01's own photos

rows.pain: dark garment on similar background, no mask
rows.note: needs real photo, not run: no committed garment is dark on a matching background; darkening one would change the garment, not the photo

needs real photo, not run: white balance runs only on a near-neutral garment (C* <= 8) and no committed garment is that neutral, so it needs a grey or white garment shot under coloured light; a light ramp on shirt-plaid trips the shadow check before the correction check (offline synthetic check in test/sp1.test.ts, not a run case: ramp to 0.5 passes with correction dE 3.27, ramp to 0.4 fails on shadow 0.61)

limits: Synthetic cases are one pixel transform of the owner's shirt-plaid front photo, so they test the checks, not a seller's real phone.
shirt-plaid is the base because its untouched front passes composite v2's pre-check; the untouched kurta-01 and kurta-02 fronts already fail it on clipping.
Cases 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 11 and 12 need a real photo and were not run.
A disagreement is a finding to report; no threshold was changed for it.
